_why:
THE HOLE THAT COMES OUT HALF OUTSIDE AND SAYS «SUCCEEDED» (entry E13). RUN IT AFTER e2_block.json, because it cites F6 and the identifiers come from a reading: node Bench/run_plans.js Bench/cases/bridge/e2_block.json Bench/cases/bridge/e13_hole_on_the_border.json

F6 is the right face of the 100x60x20 block: it goes from Z=0 to Z=20, and the point (0,0) of its local plane falls on the LOWER EDGE. Half of the hole ends up in the void.

It is NOT reproduced with face_ref top_face: there the point (0,0) falls in the middle of the face and the hole comes out whole. The defect lives on the SIDE faces, which the vocabulary of roles cannot name -- and it is exactly the 58% of faces without a role measured in E7.

MEASURED on 14/9/2026, before the repair: 196.3 mm3 removed instead of the 392.7 of pi*5^2*5; the bottom of the hole a half disc of 39.27 mm2 instead of 78.54; cylindrical surface 78.54 instead of 157.08. And the operation answered «succeeded: true», «walls_drilled: 1».

EXPECTED from 0.29.0: succeeded TRUE -- the operation succeeded and the part exists, refusing now would mean throwing away a feature already made on a suspicion -- plus «removed_mm3»: 196.3, «expected_mm3»: 392.7 and a «note_volume» that says 50% less.
